The sign-in duration is set in `src/server/services/session-service.ts`. The expiry check on later requests is in `src/server/repositories/session-repository.ts`, and `src/lib/session.ts` repeats it.

1. **At sign-in (how long the session lasts):** `SESSION_TTL_DAYS = 30` in `createSessionToken()` (`src/server/services/session-service.ts`) computes `expiresAt`. `login()` in `src/server/services/auth-service.ts` calls it, and `loginAction` in `src/actions/auth/login.ts` passes that value to `setSessionCookie()` in `src/lib/session.ts`, which only applies it to the cookie.

2. **On a later request (the moment has passed):** `findSessionByTokenHash()` in `src/server/repositories/session-repository.ts` returns `null` when `row.session.expiresAt <= now`. `getSessionPrincipal()` in `src/lib/session.ts` makes the same comparison and returns `null` if it fails. The dashboard layout (`src/app/(dashboard)/layout.tsx`) then calls `redirect("/login")`. `src/proxy.ts` only checks that the cookie exists, so it does not make this decision.

The expiry comparison appears in two files. I included both because each one returns `null` for an expired session. If you want only the authoritative filter, that is `session-repository.ts`.

ANSWER: src/server/services/session-service.ts, src/server/repositories/session-repository.ts, src/lib/session.ts
